summary: Hawkish FOMC minutes (Fed came close to an October hike; broad support for more hikes) lifted yields near 5% and the dollar near a 19-month high; Dow fell 561 points, Nvidia reversed lower, gold hit a 14-month low.
events_next_24h: Thu 11:00pm USD Walmart Q3 earnings (date unconfirmed)
Fri 10:30am JPY National CPI (Oct), just after the 24h window
tier1_next_14d: US PCE + personal income (Oct) and Q3 GDP 2nd estimate · Thu, 26 Nov, 12:30am

ES.why: Hawkish Fed minutes and ~5% yields hit stocks; S&P fell again with the Dow in a losing streak. Funds neutral (35th pct), no crowding to fight.
ES.risk: A dovish Fed speaker or soft jobless claims that pull hike odds down.

NQ.why: Nvidia gave back its post-earnings gains as rate-hike talk grew; funds are crowded long (98th pct), so there is room to unwind.
NQ.risk: Nasdaq held up on the day; a strong AI bid (Anthropic IPO buzz) could squeeze shorts.

YM.why: Dow fell 561 points (-1.1%), extending its losing streak after the hawkish Fed minutes.
YM.risk: Walmart earnings beat or falling yields reviving value stocks.

RTY.why: Small caps are the most rate-sensitive; more Fed hikes and ~5% yields are a headwind. Lean only, no fresh RTY price data found.
RTY.risk: Yields reversing lower on weak data.

NKD.why: Nikkei down 3.6% in 5 days on the tech rout; Nvidia's reversal weighs on Japan chip names. Funds neutral (46th pct).
NKD.risk: Weak yen boosting exporters, or Japan CPI tomorrow shifting BOJ bets.

6E.why: Dollar near a 19-month high as markets price a Fed hike; EUR/USD pressing major support.
6E.risk: Support at multi-year lows holding and a dollar pullback.

6J.why: Hawkish Fed pushes USD/JPY up, but it stalls near 160 under Japan intervention warnings and a likely December BOJ hike. Funds leaning long yen (77th pct).
6J.risk: Actual intervention (yen spikes) or a break above 160 (yen slides).

6B.why: Broad US-dollar strength on Fed hike bets; no UK-specific driver found.
6B.risk: A dollar reversal or hawkish BoE surprise.

6A.why: Strong dollar and risk-off stocks weigh on the Aussie, a risk-sensitive currency.

ZN.why: Minutes showed broad support for more hikes; 10-year yields near 5% means bond prices falling.
ZN.risk: Weak data or risk-off flight to safety lifting bonds.

GC.why: Gold broke below $3,800 to a 14-month low as hike bets lifted the dollar and yields. Funds 21st pct, not yet crowded short.
GC.risk: Dollar reversal or a geopolitical shock (Hormuz) sending buyers back.

CL.why: Oil slipped on a US stockpile build, but Hormuz risk lingers and funds are crowded short (10th pct), which could fuel a squeeze.
CL.risk: Fresh Middle East supply headline (up) or more inventory builds (down).
